findings.title: Materials' 67-point lens gap signals collapse
findings.body: Materials trades at 15.93x forward yet 34.21x trailing, a 67-point percentile gap — the widest in the table. The market is underwriting 115 percent earnings growth, which would be a historic reversal for a sector whose forward percentile has fallen 12 points in a month.

findings.title: Energy's cheap forward mask hides rich past
findings.body: Energy's forward P/E sits at the 42nd percentile while its trailing multiple ranks at the 84th, a 41-point split. The 62 percent implied earnings growth is the market's bet that the current earnings trough is temporary, but the one-month 14-point cheapening suggests fading conviction.

findings.title: Consumer Staples' week-long valuation spike
findings.body: Consumer Staples jumped 28 percentile points in forward valuation over a single week, the largest weekly move in the table. That surge has pushed its forward P/E to 19.81 against a trailing 27.41, implying 38 percent growth — a bold assumption for a defensive sector that has historically delivered steady, low-double-digit earnings.
